summary.text: Get a referral from a CHAS clinic or polyclinic. CHAS clinics require a PG, MG or CHAS card.

details.heading: Using a CHAS clinic
details.body: You need to be a PG, MG or CHAS cardholder to get a subsidised SOC referral from a CHAS clinic.

steps.name: Choose a clinic
steps.text: Choose either a CHAS clinic or a polyclinic.

steps.name: Ask for a referral
steps.text: Ask the clinic for a referral for subsidised care at a public SOC.

example_phrasings: How can I get a referral for subsidised care at public SOCs?
How do I get subsidised SOC care?

sources.page_title: How can I get a referral for subsidised care at public SOCs?

quotes.text: A referral for subsidised care at public SOCs can be obtained from either CHAS clinics or polyclinics.
Do note that you will need to be a PG/MG/CHAS cardholder to obtain subsidised SOC referrals from CHAS clinics.
